verdict.rationale: Warp's own docs say it does not allow OpenAI or Anthropic to use your data for model training, and that terminal input/output is never stored on Warp servers. Business and Enterprise plans add a Zero Data Retention agreement under which no AI interaction or console data is collected, and secret redaction is applied unconditionally to AI interactions. A community report that Prompt Suggestions sent session data to LLMs without explicit consent concerns data being sent, not training, so it lowers confidence but does not contradict the no-training claim. Missing for 10: a stated no-training guarantee for other model providers (Gemini, open models like Kimi, MiniMax, Qwen), ZDR-level guarantees for Free and Pro tiers, and independent verification of the no-training policy.
